raw.rationale: Chlorthalidone is a thiazide-like diuretic whose known targets (carbonic anhydrases, SLC12A1/3) are not established cancer lineage dependencies, and PRISM single-agent screens of such drugs typically show no lineage-selective killing above base rates. Thus probabilities are near the low end of the 0.2-2.5% per-lineage base rate, with minor variation for lineages where CA/SLC expression or transporter biology might marginally increase sensitivity.
